_readme: Entity registry per docs/SPEC.md §15. Never hardcode public/private status elsewhere — read it from here. Verify public entities against SEC EDGAR (data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK##########.json, UA header required). Weekly registry sweep runs in the Saturday routine; entities with recheck_trigger 'EDGAR weekly sweep' get an EDGAR full-text/submissions re-check every Saturday. NEVER invent a price or valuation for a private company.

public.share_classes: dual (Class A traded, Class B 10x votes)
public.note: CRITICAL: the ticker 'SPCX' belonged to the unrelated Tuttle ETF until 2026-04-07 (that fund is now SPCK). SpaceX price history begins 2026-06-12 — NEVER backfill earlier SPCX data. First quarterly report as a public company (Q2 2026, 8-K + 10-Q) filed 2026-08-04.

private.ipo_preparation: Confidential S-1 filing reported 2026-06-08 (targeted Q3/Q4 2026 at a valuation near $1T) — now reportedly weighing a delay into 2027 following SpaceX's public debut, per press reports 2026-07-24/26. Press-reported only, NOT confirmed on public EDGAR.
private.source: Press reports (TechCrunch, Barchart, IndMoney; confidential filing; no public EDGAR record as of last_verified).
